_readme: Every ad slot is driven from this file. Slot keys name the page they sit on. Four creative types: image, video, flier and text. linkType controls where a click goes: 'website' (external, nofollow sponsored), 'profile' (their listing on this site — set firmSlug), or 'none' (no link at all, for brand awareness). Every running campaign needs an 'end' date: the advertiser bought a period, not a permanent slot, and the admin blocks a save without one. The Add-your-firm, Privacy and Terms pages carry no advertising. Rotation: several campaigns can share one slot and take turns. Set 'weight' higher to show a campaign more often (a Platinum advertiser might be 3, a filler 1). Every creative in a slot must be the slot's own size — nothing is ever stretched, a mismatch letterboxes. These sample entries are placeholders; replace them before launch.
